scope: Persistent cache correctness and counted content reads on owned ordinary fixtures. No native IPC interaction, UI automation, UAC, startup or whole-app performance claim.

fixture.expectedDigest: literal BLAKE3 of 16,384 bytes with value 7

verifiedBehavior: Migration from equivalent schema 4 preserves both saved snapshots and their totals
Reopened connections reuse complete hashes only after opening and validating the file stamp
Wrong-sized SQLite digest rows are ignored and ordinary hashing repairs the cache
Same-size edits with preserved modification time invalidate native change-time evidence
Cancelled cache replacement rolls back and preserves the previous table
Explicit cache clearing removes hashes while both snapshots remain readable

counterexample.mutation: Both cache predicates compare size and modification time while omitting native change time.
counterexample.failure: changed.groups.is_empty() fails because edited content is grouped using an old hash

sourceReviewedBehavior: Native cache failures report issues and fall back to ordinary hashing
Memory cache is local to duplicate operations; no startup load or retained Engine cache field
